article_gender_roles_expectations.summary: A gender role is a rule about what a category of people is expected to do. After reading this you can tell a role from a stereotype, name who enforces the rule around you, see how the cost of breaking it falls on one person, and negotiate a division of work at home or at work before the next crisis decides it for you.
article_gender_roles_expectations.title: Gender Roles and Social Expectations
